description: This file contains a 'Validators' class with static methods for validating various input fields such as email, phone, OTP, password, and name. It primarily provides regex-based validation and field requirement checks for form input validation in a Flutter application.

classes.name: Validators
classes.description: A utility class providing static validation methods for email, phone, OTP, password, and name fields.

methods.name: requiredText
methods.description: Checks if a provided string is empty; returns an error message if required.

methods.name: phone
methods.description: Validates that a phone number matches E.164-like pattern.

methods.name: emailOptional
methods.description: Validates an email address only if it is provided.

methods.name: phoneOrEmail
methods.description: Validates that input is either a valid phone number or email address.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Checks that the password meets minimal length requirements.

methods.name: otp
methods.description: Validates OTP input conforms to digit length and format.

methods.name: fullNameOptional
methods.description: Validates optional full name, ensuring it's not too short if provided.
